defects.quote: a Sharpe gap of 2.5 over a year is far above the detectable size for 252 days
defects.evidence: Over 252 days with correlation 0.6, the standard error of a daily Sharpe difference is about √((2−2·0.6+≈0.016)/252) ≈ 0.057, or ≈ 0.90 annualised. A 2.5 gap is about 2.8 standard errors. The Bonferroni one-sided critical value for 18 claims at 5% is ≈ 2.77, so each of the five required seed-404 claims has only ~50% power. The detectable difference at 80% power is ≈ (2.77+0.84)·0.90 ≈ 3.3 annualised Sharpe, above the planted 2.5. TC-72's seed-404 expectation would likely fail for a correct implementation.
defects.fix: Raise the planted gap well above the detectable size, e.g. `topfifth:neural` at annualised Sharpe 5.0 against 0.5 (gap 4.5 ≈ 5 SE), or use sessions=756. Replace the tolerance note with: 'the planted gap is ≈ 5 standard errors; the detectable gap at 252 days and family 18 is ≈ 3.3'. Regenerate tests/fixtures/qfcst/TC-72. Also state in docs/architecture.md Risks (Paper-trading power) that 12 months detects only ≈ 3 Sharpe of difference.

defects.quote: about 69 holdout months detect a mean monthly IC of roughly 0.025 or more
defects.evidence: FREP-02 asks for the detectable IC 'at the family's corrected level'. With a monthly IC spread of 0.10 over 69 months, SE = 0.012. At 80% power and 19 claims Bonferroni-corrected (z ≈ 3.0), the detectable mean IC is ≈ (3.0+0.84)·0.012 ≈ 0.046. Even uncorrected at 5% two-sided it is ≈ 0.034. 0.025 overstates the holdout's power by about 2×.
defects.fix: Replace with 'about 69 holdout months detect a mean monthly IC of roughly 0.045 or more at the family-corrected level (≈ 0.034 uncorrected); smaller real effects will read as "does not pass".'

defects.quote: **Expected:** no seed's difference rejects H0
defects.evidence: TC-19 says 'no seed' in Expected but 'at most 1 of the 20 seeds may reject' in Tolerance. More generally, TC-19, qfeat TC-38 ('at most 1 of the 20 seeds has any claim pass'), qfcst TC-58 and qfcst TC-72 ('at most 1 seed has any of the 18 claims pass') all use a 20-seed, at-most-1 rule. With a correctly sized 5% test, P(≥ 2 of 20 reject) = 1 − 0.95²⁰ − 20·0.05·0.95¹⁹ ≈ 0.26, so roughly a quarter of correct implementations fail each case.
defects.fix: Make the criterion statistically sound in all four cases: either 100 seeds with 'at most 10 reject' (P(fail) < 1% at α = 0.05), or 20 seeds with 'at most 3 reject' (P(fail) ≈ 1.6%). In TC-19 change Expected to match the Tolerance. Files: docs/packages/qrisk/tests.md TC-19, docs/packages/qfeat/tests.md TC-38, docs/packages/qfcst/tests.md TC-58 and TC-72; regenerate their fixtures.

defects.evidence: Features are computed only 'for every eligible member' (FEAT Behavior), and STRUCT-02 makes a member eligible only with ≥ 252 of the 504 window days ('given one with 200, then it is not'). FEAT-09's example, and qfeat TC-30 built on it, test a case that can't occur, while the reachable case (an eligible member whose gaps leave momentum's span short) isn't tested.
defects.fix: FEAT-09 criterion: 'Given an eligible member with 300 trading days of history on R, of which fewer than 231 fall in the momentum span (252 to 21 days before R), when momentum is computed, then it has no value, and reversal, volatility and maximum return do.' Update qfeat TC-30's Source to the same member, and regenerate its fixture.

defects.quote: **Outline:** A check run with the cross-check runs from the app on the synthetic version; the user filters failures and explains one, and the summary counts follow.
defects.evidence: Every Designed milestone needs a checkable **Exit:** line. Only M1 has one; M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9 and M10 have Outline/Skills/References and no Exit.
defects.fix: Add an **Exit:** line under each of M2–M10, e.g. M2: 'From the app, a check run with the cross-check completes on synthetic version 1; filtering by one check and "failed" shows only its unexplained failures; explaining one updates the summary counts; PL-03, PL-05 and PL-06 smoke tests pass.' M4: '`qrisk known-answers` passes and `qrisk study run` on M1's synthetic version writes the scorecard, tests and report; TC-01–TC-21 pass.' Likewise M3, M5–M10 from their Outlines (named commands, the TC ranges, and the timed QR on real data for M3, M5, M7 and M10).

defects.quote: **Read:** PL-09, PL-04, load.download, runs.RunInfo, core.RunContext
defects.evidence: M1-T19's execute_run must call `load.download(kind, store, source, ctx)`. Its step input is 'RunInfo, RunContext, CheckConfig' with no VersionedStore, and its packet has no store.VersionedStore, sources.PrimarySource or `open_primary` signature, so the builder can't construct either argument from the packet.
defects.fix: Add store.VersionedStore, store.DataVersion and sources.PrimarySource to M1-T19's Read line. Change PL-09 step 5's input to 'RunInfo, RunContext, CheckConfig, home', and pass `home` in the entry sketch so execute_run opens `VersionedStore(home)`.
